Monte Carlo precision of bootstrap confidence interval limits

pb_confint_mc_error.Rd

Reports finite-replicate uncertainty of the endpoints of quantile-based bootstrap confidence intervals.

Usage

pb_confint_mc_error(
  results,
  level = 0.95,
  type = c("percentile", "basic", "normal", "student"),
  mc_level = 0.95
)

Arguments

results

A pb_boot object from pb_simulate or pb_parallel.

level

Coverage level for the underlying bootstrap confidence interval.

type

One of "percentile", "basic", or "student". Normal limits use approximate joint delta-method Monte Carlo bounds, including mean/SD covariance.

mc_level

Per-endpoint Monte Carlo confidence level, separate from level.

Details

Distribution-free order-statistic bounds for each bootstrap tail quantile are derived using binomial ranks, then mapped into percentile, basic or studentised confidence interval units. The Monte Carlo bounds apply separately to the lower and upper endpoint; they are not a joint region. Unbounded bounds signal too few bootstrap replicates to provide a finite rank guarantee for a tail quantile. For normal confidence intervals, joint delta-method bounds use empirical mean/SD covariance and are approximate, not distribution-free rank bounds. These require at least four finite estimates and positive spread. The method conditions on independently simulated, successful finite refits and does not measure statistical sampling or model uncertainty. Parameters without usable studentised confidence intervals have missing Monte Carlo bounds.

Value

A data frame with term, the original unmodified lower and upper confidence interval endpoints, lower_mc_low, lower_mc_high, upper_mc_low, upper_mc_high, and replicates.

See also

pb_confint, pb_mc_error, pb_lrt_mc_error

Examples

model <- lm(mpg ~ wt, data = mtcars)
result <- pb_simulate(model, n = 30, seed = 7, keep_fits = FALSE)
pb_confint_mc_error(result, level = 0.8, mc_level = 0.9)
#>          term     lower     upper lower_mc_low lower_mc_high upper_mc_low
#> 1 (Intercept) 35.517189 38.002131    33.559757     35.925463    37.725176
#> 2          wt -5.587498 -4.817599    -6.635923     -5.487411    -4.954131
#>   upper_mc_high replicates
#> 1     41.239202         30
#> 2     -4.158725         30
